dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregularly shaped, light-grey closed loops and 'C' shaped perimeters with sharp pixel intensity transitions from the dark grey background to the light interior edges, prominent across the upper-mid dorsal surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical, solid light-grey pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated along the lower lateral flank and towards the posterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent rings on the upper dorsal section form an elongated trapezoidal configuration, while three smaller blobs near the mid-body transition form an approximate scalene triangle.
